html.t-att-data-balance-url: ('/' + db_name + '/' + tournament.slug + '/auction/show/team/balance') if db_name and tournament and tournament.slug else ''
html.t-att-data-rp-url: ('/' + db_name + '/' + tournament.slug + '/auction/display_auction/remaining-players?theme=blackberry') if db_name and tournament and tournament.slug else ''

t.t-value: tournament or (player.tournament_id if player else None)

div.t-att-style: ('--tier-color:' + player.tier_id.color + '; color:' + player.tier_id.color + '; border-color:' + player.tier_id.color + '55; background:' + player.tier_id.color + '15;') if player.tier_id else ''

t.t-esc: (tournament or player.tournament_id).format_points(player.effective_base_price or 0) if (tournament or (player and player.tournament_id)) else '{:,}'.format(int(player.effective_base_price or 0))
